name: The Museum of Opportunity
summary:
Learn all about "careers" and make a few friends along the way! This collection of murals will teach you to grab life by the collar and shout "PRODUCTIVITY" in its dirty face!

To view a mural, click outside of the dialogue window.

Created for Archive.org's DiscMaster Game Jam, April 20th-29th- all game assets except for text content were sourced from the DiscMaster CD-ROM archive.

May be buggy, just like life!
